newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.4 Dec 20 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.4 Dec 20 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 105.4 in the week ended December 20 from a revised 105.3 the previous week, ECRI said.
The growth rates of real estate loans and industrial materials prices both rose, it said, adding that the insured unemployment rate was unchanged.
"(The FIGs) behavior since late 1995 correctly anticipated the current benign inflationary environment, and its first release in the new year points to stable inflation ahead," ECRI said.
